inputs.label: Star Wars arcade ROM set (MAME starwars)
inputs.help: Your own MAME starwars.zip. Leave it zipped.

steps.why: The first start shows NO ROMS and creates Android/data/com.cyberheater.starwars/files.

steps.text: Open Star Wars from Library > Unknown Sources. The game finds the ROM set and starts.

notes: The app finds the chips in any zip in its folder by checksum. The first start with the zip writes six starwars_*.bin files beside it. Release v0.2 also carried QuestSWVR-rom-tools.zip, which the asset pattern does not match.
